verdict.rationale: The Venture & Growth Tech page explicitly states coverage 'from seed capital to IPOs' and cites deal volume ('more than 70 transactions a year, amounting to more than €9.2 billion raised or invested... over the past 18 years'), plus a Chambers Band 1 ranking and a representative M&A transaction. Missing for 10: named representative priced-equity financing deals (e.g., specific Series A/B/C rounds) rather than only aggregate stats, and independent third-party confirmation of the deal volume figures.
